title: HPV 3-dose series for immunocompromising conditions incl. HIV

source.quote: Immunocompromising conditions, including HIV infection: 3-dose series, even for those who initiate vaccination at age 9 through 14 years.

all.quote: catch-up HPV vaccination recommended for all persons through age 18 years

derived.min: routine series is at 11–12 years; a patient is only overdue once past that window, i.e. from 13
